tokens_provenance.canvas: lifted from site --background #09090b to the site's own dark surface --surface #14171d (luma ~23, still dark/native): the near-black #09090b dominated the frame and dragged mean luma under the brightness floor; #14171d keeps the inky native identity while lifting the frame across every scene
tokens_provenance.ink: site css var --text #f4f4f5 (luma 244, clears the >=230 dark-canvas ink floor)
tokens_provenance.accent: site css var --blue #3b82f6 (75 uses in site.generated.css, with --blue-glow; the extractor's --primary read a neutral gray, corrected to the site's real accent blue, hue 217)

readability.accent_as_text: text-scale accent auto-derives --accent-ink (~205 luma); raw #3b82f6 stays on the aurora field, dots, glows and the inverted flash field; green #22c55e is the connected-state pulse
readability.muted_content: pane detail rows and activity lines use --muted-content (muted lifted 60% toward ink); raw ink_muted only for the corner wordmark ticker
bright_beats: FRICTION: large bright cream hero lines on near-black (scene 1)
ONER_MONEY: the centered glide line is large bright cream, a real light source at frame center (scene 5)
ONE_ENDPOINT: full-bleed BRIGHT blue flash, inverted field / dark ink (scene 6)
readability.inverted_beat: scene 6 flash (bright blue field, dark ink)
readability.frame_brightness_plan: dark canvas, no shader (07-11 used it). Aurora blue field lifts the base; >=3 genuinely bright beats (s1 hero type, s5 oner centered line, s6 full-bleed blue flash) plus bright value cards in s2 target >=30% bright scenes so the frame-brightness gate passes without lifting in the grade.
readability.notes: oner centered line must be LARGE (coverage lesson from 07-08/07-10/07-11): a short bright word on the aurora field needs to own >0.7% of pixels or the top percentile reads the lit field behind it.

color_gate_note: accent blue hue 217: >=60deg off orange-17 (07-11) with large dE00, AND a dark<->light canvas-value flip vs the light 07-10 teal run. Clears the variety color gate against both previous videos (value flip vs 07-10, hue+dE vs 07-11).
